lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The group chat wakes up after months asleep. Forty-one messages in ten minutes.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: TAQUERÍA. Tonight. It's open late and everyone's asking about you. In??

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The group chat wakes up. First one tagged: you. Burgers earned you that.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: TAQUERÍA. Tonight. It's open late. You in??

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The group chat wakes up. Your name comes up like a question.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: TAQUERÍA tonight. You in this time?? No pressure. Some pressure.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: The place behind the laundromat. Trust the process.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Someone posts a blurry photo of tacos. It looks like evidence, not dinner.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: Also someone's bringing a karaoke speaker. This is your only warning.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The chat votes. You're officially expected. Your early shift clears its throat.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: Everyone throws in for their share. So — actually coming?

beats.prompt: First invite in a long time.

choices.label: Go, but just for a soda.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Tacos, bad jokes, truly terrible karaoke. Nobody asks about the sirens.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: Told you the laundromat place was real.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: For three hours you're just a person at a table.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You nurse one soda and stay two hours anyway.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Turns out the company was the thing, not the tacos.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The chat posts photos until 1 a.m.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You sleep early, wake rested, and scroll through the night you didn't have.
